main_text.p: tus eius sunt ad desertum Bethauen.
13 Illinc autem pertransiit termi-nus in Luz ad latus Luz Australe (ipsa est Bet-hel) & descendit terminus in Ateroth-Adar, iuxta montem, qui est à Meridie ipsi Beth-horon inferiori.

14 Et designatur terminus, circuitque ad latus Maris ad Meridiem, à monte qui est eregione Beth-horon ad Meridiem: sunt que exitus eius ad Ciriath-Baal (ipsa est Ciriath-Iearim) urbe filiorum Iehuda, hoc est latus Maris.
15 Latus autem ad Meridiem, ab extremo Ciriath-Iearim: itaque exit terminus ad mare, exit inquam, ad fontem aquarum Nephthoah.

16 Et descendit terminus ad extre-um montis, qui est eregione vallis Ben-hinnom, quique est in valle Rephaim ad Aquilonem, descenditque ad vallē Hinnō ad latus Iebusæi, ad Meridiem, & illinc descendit ad En-rogel.

page.notes: Several words are set in a worn or blurred state: "extre-um" (line of v.16) probably "extremum" with a lost letter; "Hinnō" and "vallē" carry the printed macron forms as shown. Verse numbers 13–17 are printed in the text column and are kept as printed.
